method: Extracted the literal $validator here-string from the setup script and executed it with python3 -I - against a disposable hardlink copy restricted to the 140 official manifest paths. Corruption tests replaced only disposable clone files; original payload files were not modified.

cases.name: Corrupted payload file
cases.observed: Runtime size/hash mismatch; no runtime publication

cases.name: Duplicated path with omitted manifest entry
cases.observed: Unexpected, missing or duplicate extraction manifest paths; no runtime publication

cases.name: Authentic complete R28 payload and current game module
cases.observed: Validated all 140 official payload files, both data ZIP CRCs, AMD64 engine and copied game module. No engine execution was performed.

limitations: Linux-only test of embedded Python validator. It does not validate the Windows PowerShell wrapper, network download flow, Windows file permissions, process startup or gameplay.
